what.text: This page follows refugees from Serbia and Kosovo living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 18522 of these refugees in France, 62.4% of all refugees from Serbia and Kosovo.
France is the largest host, followed by Germany, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kosovo territory in Serbia with the UCK in 1998 and 1999, at war level.
It also records armed conflict over Croatia territory in 1991 and 1992 and over Slovenia territory in 1991.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 15000 refugees, and the figure fell to a low in 2000.
It then rose again, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1994 and 2009 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
UNHCR reports Serbia and Kosovo as one origin; these are year-end totals for France only.
